name: CJ Logistics Corporation
summary: CJ Logistics Corporation delivers a comprehensive spectrum of logistics and transportation solutions, catering to both private customers and corporate clients throughout South Korea and internationally. Its diverse operations encompass contract logistics, parcel delivery, freight forwarding, global express shipping, port stevedoring, general transportation, and specialized project logistics. Established in 1930, the company was previously known as Korea Express Co., Ltd. and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. CJ Logistics Corporation operates as a subsidiary of CJ Corporation.
